messages:
inc-bot: PagerDuty: SEV2 - dedicated-pool-usw2 saturation & streaming-tail triggered at 18:10 UTC. Rule fired: sustained_queue_depth > 700 && p99 > 4s.

pagerduty: paging ana.r (primary) and lee.v (backup) per infra-sre policy.

ana.r: taking it. initial dashboards show a rapid queue build and streaming sessions pausing mid-stream.

lee.v: numbers: queue_depth from ~40 -> 870 in ~2.5 minutes. p95 went 200ms -> 1.7s, p99 jumped 1.1s -> 7.9s. streaming reconnects up ~350%.

pat: are there recent autoscaler or image changes? any deploys in the last hour?

ana.r: no model pushes. infra events show node creation delays and a flurry of registry 429s. autoscaler requested +5 nodes at 18:11 but only 2 nodes became Ready by 18:13. warmup_inflight stuck at 1-2.

infra-bot: kube events excerpt:
```
18:11:05 dp-usw2-7 pod/worker-21 ContainerCreating
18:11:12 dp-usw2-7 pod/worker-22 Failed to pull image: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = 429 Too Many Requests
18:12:30 dp-usw2-7 pod/worker-23 Pulling
18:13:40 dp-usw2-7 pod/worker-22 ImagePullBackOff
18:13:55 dp-usw2-7 node/pool-az3 NodeNotReady: provisioning delay
```

samira: likely root contributors: registry throttling + AZ provisioning slowness + warmup serialized JIT/quant tasks delaying KV priming. That combo explains streaming tailing behavior.

lee.v: mitigation plan (fast): 1) divert 35% traffic to us-east-1, 2) apply per-tenant temporary concurrency caps for top noisy tenants, 3) enable chunked-resend fallback for streaming sessions to reduce stalls, 4) pre-pull images onto warm standby nodes, 5) manual bump desired capacity where cloud allows. executing.

ana.r: starting cross-region diversion: `infra-route shift --pool dp-usw2-7 --to-region us-east-1 --pct 35 --reason "inc-3317770000"`

pat: pre-pull command: `infra nodes prepull --pool dp-usw2-7 --image registry.redwood/serve:stable --nodes 6 --async`

lee.v: manual desired bump: `infra-scale set --pool dp-usw2-7 --desired 18` (was 10). note: cloud reports some instance queueing; expected partial fill within 70-110s.

samira: enabling temporary per-tenant token bucket for top-five: `POST /internal/tenants/bulk-throttle --tenants=top5 --rps=5`

ana.r: activating streaming chunked-resend fallback (this makes clients fall back to small non-stream ack chunks if stall detected): `PATCH /internal/streams/config?chunked_resend=true&pool=dp-usw2-7`

infra-bot: diversion confirmed: 35% traffic -> us-east-1. divert-rps=378/s.

pat: 4-minute check: queue_depth 870 -> 390. p95 improved to ~360ms; p99 down to ~2.1s. streaming errors decreased but some sessions still show long tail spikes at token boundaries.

lee.v: digging deeper: warmup_serialization metric shows 92% serialized for init sequence; KV cache fill step blocked until heavy kernel JIT/quant completes. we should fast-track warmup parallelism.

samira: root-cause hypothesis: registry rate limits caused Node provisioning lag which interacted with a recent autoscaler cooldown tweak (increased cooldown from 60s -> 150s last week) so autoscaler waited too long to request additional capacity, leaving manual scaling as the primary mitigation which came late.

ana.r: immediate operational fixes: - revert cooldown override for dedicated pools to 60s, - set warmup default parallelism=4, - add a pre-pull lifecycle hook for nodes marked Ready; will also add registry retry/backoff with jitter.

pat: customer impact: 4 tenants reported degraded streaming; 1 enterprise (GammaAnalytics) opened a priority ticket (TCK-9123). CS notified and live-update posted to status page.

lee.v: incident INC-45890 created. assigning postmortem: samira (root cause), pat (customer comms), lee.v (infra followups).

infra-bot: pre-pull status: started async job on 6 nodes; 5 completed image pull within 22s, 1 still in progress.

ana.r: after pre-pull + diversion + manual scale p95 stable ~300-350ms, p99 ~1.1s. queue_depth at 18:24 -> 90. streaming stalls down to ~0.6%.

samira: follow-ups to include in postmortem: 1) enforce smaller autoscaler cooldown for dedicated pools; 2) pre-pull images as part of autoscaler life-cycle; 3) add registry error-rate & 429 dashboards with alert thresholds; 4) make warmup parallelism configurable per pool and raise default; 5) add cross-region emergency diversion playbook; 6) audit any recent autoscaler config changes last 30 days.

pat: for immediate customer remediation, offering credit and runbook summary. CS on-call acknowledged and is drafting messages for GammaAnalytics.

lee.v: Handoff: I'm staying on pager for 30m. ana, write the timeline and drop into the incidents/ inbox. samira, please drive the RCA and track infra action items.

inc-bot: Incident INC-45890 status=mitigated -> partial mitigation applied (divert + pre-pull + manual scale + throttles). Monitoring open for 30m.

ana.r: handing watch to lee-monitor alias. closing this thread for active ops; will reopen if p99 > 3s or queue_depth > 600.
